name: High-Methoxyl Pectin HM-450
regulatoryNotes: Declared as E440(i) pectin under Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008, quantum satis in fermented milk and dessert categories. Purity criteria per Regulation (EU) No 231/2012: minimum 65% galacturonic acid on ash-free dried basis, degree of esterification above 50%. Permitted in EU organic production under Regulation (EU) 2018/848 Annex V. Sole qualified source is SUP-EU-014, which represents an accepted-risk single-source exposure logged in the group risk register as RISK-SC-2023-011.

name: Low-Methoxyl Pectin LM-220 (amidated)
regulatoryNotes: Declared as E440(ii) amidated pectin. Calcium-dependent gelling; requires a calcium salt in the fruit preparation. NOT permitted in EU organic production under Regulation (EU) 2018/848 Annex V, therefore unusable on organic-certified Naturel and Kids SKUs. Switching a SKU from E440(i) to E440(ii) changes the ingredient declaration and triggers artwork rework.

name: Bovine Gelatin 220 Bloom
regulatoryNotes: Bovine-derived; requires TSE/BSE compliance documentation under Regulation (EC) No 1069/2009. Use destroys vegetarian, Halal and Kosher claims and mandates a label change. Melts above 35 degrees Celsius, unsuitable for ambient display formats.

name: Modified Waxy Maize Starch E1442
regulatoryNotes: Hydroxypropyl distarch phosphate, declared as E1442 or 'modified starch'. Conflicts with clean-label positioning on the Naturel range. Not permitted in EU organic production. Sensory panels consistently down-rate starch-set fruit preparations for pasty mouthfeel.

name: Raw Whole Milk (farm collection)
regulatoryNotes: Regulation (EC) No 853/2004 hygiene requirements for raw milk. Collected on 48-hour cycles from cooperative farms; plate count and somatic cell count tested per collection. Not transferable between plants due to cold-chain and shelf-life constraints.

name: Skimmed Milk Powder (medium heat)
regulatoryNotes: Used for protein standardisation on the Pro range. Ambient storage below 25 degrees Celsius. Freely transferable between plants.

name: Sweet Cream 35% Fat
regulatoryNotes: Chilled 2-6 degrees Celsius throughout. Short shelf life restricts reallocation to lanes under 24 hours transit.

name: Yogurt Starter Culture YC-X11
regulatoryNotes: Frozen DVS culture, stored at minus 45 degrees Celsius. Streptococcus thermophilus and Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus. Strain change requires full sensory and shelf-life re-validation; treated as a formulation change.

name: Crystalline Sucrose (EU beet)
regulatoryNotes: Bulk silo delivery at the Rennes and Bremen sites. Soluble solids contribution is critical to HM pectin gel formation; any sugar reduction reformulation interacts directly with the pectin system.

name: Steviol Glycosides Reb-M 95%
regulatoryNotes: E960c, authorised under Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 with category-specific maximum levels. Used on the Pro and Kids reduced-sugar variants. Lower soluble solids in stevia-sweetened recipes weaken HM pectin gel set and increase pectin usage rate.

name: Natural Vanilla Extract (Bourbon)
regulatoryNotes: Qualifies as 'natural flavouring' under Regulation (EC) No 1334/2008. Price volatility is high but supply is not currently constrained.

name: PP Cup 125g with Printed Foil Lid
regulatoryNotes: Food-contact compliance under Regulation (EU) No 10/2011 with declaration of compliance held on file. Printed lidding artwork changes require new print plates with a 6-8 week lead time; an approved over-sticker derogation valid for 90 days is the only fast alternative.
